thread.title: Universal Display Upgraded To Buy Ahead Of Earnings

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Universal Display Upgraded To Buy Ahead Of Earnings
text:
Universal Display ( OLED ), a supplier of technology and materials for OLED displays and lighting, received a stock rating upgrade on Tuesday ahead of the company's fourth-quarter earnings report due Thursday.
X Needham analyst James Ricchiuti upgraded Universal Display stock to buy from hold and set a price target of 180.
Universal Display shares climbed 4% to close at 161.10 on the stock market today . The stock hit a record high of 209 on Jan. 19 before getting hammered by the market correction.
IBD'S TAKE: Universal Display stock has an IBD Composite Rating of 94 out of a best-possible 99. For more analysis on Universal Display, visit the IBD Stock Checkup . 
"We have been trying to thread the needle on OLED since last summer, looking for the right entry point to become more constructive on the stock," Ricchiuti said in a report. "OLED shares are currently off more than 25% from their highs set last month (vs. a 1% decline for the Nasdaq)."
Expectations ahead of the company's fourth-quarter report "are clearly more cautious than prior quarters in 2017, when OLED was beating and raising estimates," he said. Plus, investors are concerned about Samsung's reported OLED oversupply and the diminished expectations for Apple 's ( AAPL ) OLED-screen iPhone X, he said. Samsung supplies the OLED displays for the iPhone X.
